description: Add a bottle to your shelf, wishlist or Tried list (same as the app's Add Bottle form). Free accounts can hold 25 unopened/opened bottles; Pro is unlimited. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

bottle_notes.description: Notes about this bottle (batch, gift, etc.)

confirm_token.description: Omit on the first call to get a preview. After the user agrees, call again with identical arguments plus this token.

name.description: Bottle name when it isn't in the catalog

status.description: unopened/opened count toward the free 25-bottle shelf; finished, wishlist and tried don't

name: add_bottle
